sample_text_with_gemma4: create a Gemma4Sampler and call sample with a text prompt to generate model output
sample_text_with_images: create a Gemma4Sampler and call sample with a text prompt and a list of images for multimodal generation
sample_text_with_audio: create a Gemma4Sampler and call sample with a text prompt and audio arrays for audio-aware generation
sample_with_stop_tokens: create a Gemma4Sampler with stop_tokens configured and call sample to halt generation at specified tokens
preprocess_images_for_vision: call _preprocess_images on a Gemma4Sampler instance to patchify and reshape a list of images into PreprocessedVisionInput
